patch_list: Free Fire MAX 120 FPS & Device Model Spoof (Experimental)

⚠️ [Experimental / Online Ban Risk] Unlocks the 120 FPS / High Refresh Rate option in Free Fire MAX by spoofing a supported gaming device model (ASUS ROG Phone 8 Pro / ASUS_AI2401) and forcing the window display refresh rate to 120Hz.
